items.summary: Completed primary funding, reported seller consideration, historical rights allocation and a repaid bridge strengthen genuine realization and productive capital recycling without validating the next ownership price.

A documented extraction pipeline and managed-service prices make productive efficiency concrete. Buyer extra-work allowances, finite paid capacity and a conditional remaining-cost budget show why the user, operator and capital owner need not retain the same gain.

A signed council purchase and Klarna’s marketing-production substitution support economically motivated demand. Two benefit tests and complete-cost boundaries show why buyer gains need not become equivalent new supplier revenue.

A matched construction account, payment-order bridge, completion-gated reserves and qualifying IREN pre-acceptance finance show how customer-backed builds can be funded—and where resources remain conditional or protected.

A connected CoreWeave–Core Scientific cash test links tenant credits, project costs, executed debt, retained cash and parent distributions. A finite refinancing can work under stated cash and funding assumptions; the same residual cannot also retire debt after it is paid out.

GECC’s named June holdings, realized distributions and own creditors show both loss absorption and funding constraints before capital is exhausted. NVIDIA’s separately dated equity and conditional support distinguish investment marks from cash calls.

29 September: selective continuation has more concrete support. The new investigation joins CoreWeave’s August older-design contract statement to older single-site Austin accounts and later conversion/financing records. These are newly connected observations, not proof of a same-day economic shift. Keeping a useful service is a real alternative; its net value still needs costs and rights. The revised weighting and limits.

Company-wide paid persistence, Freshworks’ complete expense and cash bridges, and Meta’s provider-reported embedded-monetization experiment strengthen the favorable commercial case without establishing AI-only renewal or margins.

Strong-payer protection is better supported than effortless funding or cheap spending reversibility. Complete cash accounts, lease payments, restrictions, matched-period and continuation tests, customer advances and contract-specific flexibility.

IREN remaining cash versus whole-company ownership, Microsoft required revenue growth and reinvestment, frontier funding/dilution and a revised whole answer. Includes completed versus conditional financing.

Accepted capacity and separately costed equipment/facilities sharpen the recovery test. IREN contractual timing, finite replacement cycles and conditional continuation value are compared with CoreWeave contract protection and facility-only hosting.

Contracted service cash can protect lenders while losses move to customers, equity or supplier support. Actual cash reconciliation, conditional collection/recovery tests and a bounded Meta comparison.
Subject guides, a complete research catalogue and visual explanations. Historical report routes retained.

The previous programme examined useful parts of the question but did not connect them into a whole assessment. The replacement links customer value and payment to financing, investment recovery and ownership prices. This is more than a refreshed date, but not a reversal from “everything was fictitious” to “everything is sound.” Earlier pages already included real profits and useful applications.
A March principal timetable and contract case, extended by May parent-recourse terms and June unsecured issuance. Current June-quarter and August source gaps remain explicit.
Investor-reported payments, conditional facilities, overlapping rounds and contractual guarantee gates; no mixed cash total.
Same-period cash, distinct lease/commitment measures, current accounting and funding corrections, and independent grid evidence.
A sourced baseline separating company results, funding and procurement, productivity designs and unresolved investment returns.
